mods.name: Active Loop Picker
mods.author: JC
mods.summary: Pick any stored loop as Active; saved with a red pad when none of yours is lost; auto-advance on exit.
mods.description: Pick a stored loop as the Active Loop with no playhead jump; it engages when reached. At load the rekordbox Active loop is armed. SHIFT+MEMORY cycles loops ahead. SHIFT+pad arms a hot-cue loop and, if none of yours would be lost, saves it as the Active Loop (red breathing pad). SHIFT+the pad again turns it off. Only a copy this mod saved is deleted. Analysis files are read-only. Firmware 2.00/2.01 only. The jog can show a static red ACTIVE LOOP Time and/or Bar instead of artwork (Jog shows, default Time + Bar; Off is stock; Custom is left alone). Settings sit under its Active Loop heading.

mods.name: Custom Tempo Range
mods.author: JC
mods.summary: Maps +/-6/10/16 TEMPO slots to +/-4/8/16; WIDE stays +/-100%. Shows deck BPM with 2 decimals (125.00).
mods.description: TEMPO RANGE slots +/-6/10/16 become +/-4/8/16 (each selectable, std = stock) on all four decks; WIDE stays +/-100%. Draws the deck BPM to two decimals (125.00) and the chosen +/-NN label; in the 2-deck view both follow the layer (1/3, 2/4). Firmware 2.00/2.01 (ep147-9e9454e357389ece) only: hooks TempoCtl::recompute and re-feeds ST_SET_TEMPO so playback and Link follow. Conflicts with the bpm2dp mod (both draw over the BPM digits): turn bpm2dp off.

mods.name: Fader Start
mods.author: JC
mods.summary: Channel fader start: bringing a closed channel fader up plays its deck, exiting a loop first. Off by default.
mods.description: Test build. Master row "Fader Start" is OFF by default (off, it only logs what it would do). On: a channel fader brought up from closed plays the deck on that channel from where it stands, like PLAY. If the deck is looping and "Exit loop on fader up" is on, the loop is exited first and play is called only if paused; never reloops. Learns each deck from your first PLAY press, checks every object before each call; a paused deck whose loop is unknown still plays. Disarms on any failed check (row off and on re-arms). Not while automix hooks Play. Firmware 2.00/2.01 only.
